sceneEdits.note: Nov 21 (Vico: Noah's hair looks bad). The afro01 cards' light texels and the cast finish's anisotropic sheen drew grey scratches and a cornrow pattern over a see-through scalp. Darker warm base colour on the colour map, no anisotropy, little sheen and specular: the hair reads as one full, soft, dark-brown afro. This chapter's Noah only (all his oilers models).
